title: Alan P NDE 2317
content: I had a diabetic coma at work about ten years ago. I have been a diabetic since I was thirteen. I remember talking to people in a room. I felt relaxed at peace. Of the conversation and the people, this sounds strange. I remember nothing that I can describe. The room appeared surreal brighter than normal. It was a different place and so real. I remember confusion and movement. I was yelling, 'Don't send me back! I don't want to go back!' I awoke in the casualty department of the hospital with my workmate holding me down. As far as I know the coma was not life threatening. What happened during that time seemed more real than what happened after recovery. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: Unknown NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Illness Diabetic Other Diabetic Coma Diabetic coma. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Everything seemed fresh and effortless. I was free, the world of pain had disappeared, and I was more focused. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? During the event. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual During the return. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The events were vivid. As I came back, it was as if a layer of detail was peeled away. The room was square, faces I can't remember. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place The room What emotions did you feel during the experience? Absolute peace and calm. When I returned I was almost in a panic. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither The strange thing about this event is I was not near death or I don't think so. Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal To all religious people -once you give the creator of the OMNIVERS a name you demean. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal Agnostic Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? That feeling of peace was so strong. I am a fairly highly strung person. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes One of the big questions! This is the only time this has happened. I have had many comas. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real The strength of the emotion on the return. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real No change. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? All the questions pertaining to NDE will be explained by science. I was watching a show on NDEs. A doctor stated that the soul resides in nano-structures inside cells almost at the quantum level. I read an article about Zero Point Energy in which the writer describes the quantum foam in very similar terms. This would tend to indicate that the Soul and the Universe are made of the same stuff (forgive simplification).
